testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore a View ribbon panel: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:32:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore a View ribbon panel ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the View ribbon is expanded with Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate visible ✔ When the user opens the View ribbon context menu and expand Show Panels ✔ Then Visibility, Appearance, Windows and Navigate are checked ✔ When the user selects Navigate in Show Panels ✔ Then the Navigate panel disappears from the View ribbon ✔ When the user switches to 3D Model and returns to View ✔ Then the Navigate panel remains hidden ✔ When the user reopens Show Panels on the View ribbon ✔ Then Navigate is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Navigate in Show Panels ✔ Then the Navigate panel reappears on the View ribbon
